profile.headline: SDE@Google | ex-SDE@Tesla | DS@UPenn
profile.summary:
Currently pursuing a master’s degree in data science at UPenn with outstanding academic performance of 3.92 GPA overall, possessing substantial hands-on experience in in developing and implementing operating system, distributed system-related projects.

During my internship at Caliber in 2023, I designed and developed the monthly payment summary project  facilitating 15% reduction estimated in delinquency rates for the company $60M portfolio.

I have been a key member of an R&D team with 10 people during my internship at DeemosTech to develop the mobile app Wand, which was ranked at Top 1 for download in the Graphics & Design category. The short videos of Wand have achieved 10M views on TikTok.

positions.description:
Teaching Assistant for CIS 5190: Applied Machine Learning, Spring 2024
Teaching Assistant for MEAM 5200: Introduction to Robotics, Fall 2023

positions.title: Data Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Leveraged strong T-SQL skills to construct a comprehensive monthly portfolio snapshot, drawing insights from over 300M data entries that assisted decision-making for cross-functional teams.
•	Facilitated 10% to 15% reduction in delinquency rates for $60M portfolio through implementation of the monthly payment summary.
•	Developed analytics dashboards for tracking marketing statistics using Power BI.
•	Conducted statistical analysis on pre-loan data from 13 partners, covering over 10M applications.
•	Spearheaded model evaluation and comparison against the baseline, achieving the strategic goal of boosting bidding win rate by approximately 3% on a total loan volume of $65M.

positions.title: Data Analytics Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed a social listening model that analyzed 100k lines of physician-patient dialogue to create a potential customer list for marketing team's outreach efforts.
•	Conducted entity matching of fetched data into Microsoft SQL Server database with a 95% matching accuracy, resulting in a 17% to 25% reduction in time spent linking records in datasets.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern, Computer Vision
positions.description:
•	Implemented a PyTorch-based backend neural network to develop an interactive portrait generator, leveraging GAN (Generative Adversarial Network).
•	Spearheaded a team of 10 members responsible for creating training samples and developing the front-end interface.
•	Achieved Top 1 downloaded application in App Store Graphics & Design category. Short-form videos reached over 10M views on TikTok.
